result.summary: Several layout and clipping issues make the food-delivery home screen look broken: truncated restaurant names, a partially cut-off category chip, and a bottom card that is heavily cropped by the tab bar.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with no ellipsis or wrapping in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to two lines, shrink font slightly, or use ellipsis (…); ensure card width accommodates typical names.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card is heavily cropped by the tab bar, so most of the image and any title/details below it are hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll content equal to the tab bar height so the full card (or at least its key info) is visible.

issues.description: The horizontal category chips row is cut off on the right—only a sliver of the next chip is visible with no clear affordance that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding/fade, a partial next chip, or a chevron so users understand the row is scrollable.

issues.description: Bottom navigation shows an empty Orders slot with no icon, unlike Home, Search, and Profile.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon (e.g. receipt/bag) to match the other tabs and improve scannability.
